reason: The cited evidence (E1) concerns N-doping of a different Pt-based HEA for ORR, not Ru enrichment in PtPdRhRuIrOs for ethanol oxidation. It provides no specific support for any of the key premises about Ru segregation, d-band shifts, or ethanol oxidation selectivity.
premises: Ru surface enrichment can be induced in PtPdRhRuIrOs nanoparticles by thermal/chemical treatment
Ru enrichment shifts the local d-band center of the catalyst surface
A d-band center shift optimizes adsorption energies of ethanol oxidation intermediates
Optimized adsorption energies reduce formation of strongly adsorbed poisoning species
This electronic modulation improves ethanol oxidation selectivity
